cues: Meristems are classified three ways, and each answers a different question.
By origin: where did it come from?
The promeristem is the handful of cells at the very tip.
Primary meristems come from it and build the primary body.
Secondary meristems appear later, from permanent cells that have regained the power to divide, like the cork cambium.
